args.body:
Dear City Hub Tokyo Group Bookings Team,

I am writing to inquire about group booking availability at City Hub Tokyo for a party of 10 people in June. Could you please provide information on room options, rates, and any group-specific amenities or discounts?

My name is Emma Johnson, and I am employed by Blue Sparrow Tech. I would appreciate a prompt response so we can proceed with planning our stay.

Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
